title: People
description: Everyone with an account — employees, contractors and pre-boarded new hires.
searchPlaceholder: Search name, email, username or employee ID…

empty.title: No people found
empty.description: Try a different search or clear the filters.

form.createDescription: Create a local account or pre-board a new hire. SSO users are created automatically on first sign-in.
form.editDescription: Changes are recorded in the audit log.
form.usernameHint: Used to sign in with a local account.
form.statusPendingHint: Account exists but cannot sign in until onboarded.
form.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. The person must change it at first sign-in. Leave empty for SSO-only accounts.
form.groupsHint: Groups give them their access: the roles granted to a group apply to its members.
form.displayNameHint: Filled in from the given and family names. Change it if they go by another name.

detail.mustChangePassword: Must change password at next sign-in
detail.noGroups: Not a member of any group.
detail.effectiveHint: What this person can do, and why. Department-scoped grants include every sub-department.
detail.activityHint: Changes to this person and their own actions.
detail.notFound: This person doesn’t exist, or you can’t see them.

lifecycle.suspendBody: They are signed out immediately and cannot sign in until reactivated. Their access is kept.
lifecycle.offboardBody: Disables sign-in and revokes every session. Modules are notified so they can remove access (e.g. database accounts).
lifecycle.revoked: {count, plural, =0 {No active sessions} one {# session ended} other {# sessions ended}}
lifecycle.passwordBody: Their existing sessions are signed out.
lifecycle.requireChange: Require a new password at next sign-in

groupPicker.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}

nextSteps.title: {name} is set up. What’s next?
nextSteps.description: What usually follows for a new person. This card only shows now.
nextSteps.groupsHint: Groups give them the access their team has.
nextSteps.roleHint: For access their groups don’t give them.
nextSteps.deviceHint: Pick a laptop or phone in stock and assign it to {name}.
nextSteps.onboard: Activate the account on their first day
nextSteps.onboardHint: They’re pre-boarded: choose Onboard at the top of this page when they start.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: The roles granted to these groups apply to this person.
groups.none: Not a member of any group.
groups.noneHint: Add them to the groups of their team.
groups.synced: Kept by {source}: change it in the directory
groups.added: {count, plural, =0 {Already in those groups} one {Added to # group} other {Added to # groups}}
groups.addDescription: They get the roles granted to these groups straight away.
groups.addConfirm: {count, plural, =0 {Add} one {Add to # group} other {Add to # groups}}

transfer.title: Move {name} to another department
transfer.description: Changes the department, manager, job title and groups in one step. Their old and new manager are asked to review the rest of their access.
transfer.leaveHint: Ticked: groups most of their current department is in, and the new one isn’t.
transfer.noGroups: Not a member of any group.
transfer.joinSuggested: Suggested: the groups most of the new department is in.
transfer.joinHint: Add the groups of their new team.
transfer.rolesHint: These roles apply in one department only. Tick the ones to remove.
transfer.rolesHintReadOnly: These roles apply in one department only. Ask someone who grants roles to remove the ones they no longer need.
transfer.summary: {join, plural, =0 {Joins no groups} one {Joins # group} other {Joins # groups}}, {leave, plural, =0 {leaves none} other {leaves #}}, {roles, plural, =0 {no roles removed} one {# role removed} other {# roles removed}}.
